open_procedure.name: Open Procedure
open_procedure.description: Single-stage tender — any supplier submits SQ + full ITT response together. Most common route for contracts found on Contracts Finder and Find a Tender.
open_procedure.when_to_use: Default for most contracts. Used below and above threshold.
open_procedure.evaluation_method: MAT (Most Advantageous Tender) — typically 60% quality / 30% price / 10% social value

restricted_sq.name: Restricted Procedure — Selection Questionnaire
restricted_sq.description: Stage 1 of restricted procedure. Submit SQ to demonstrate eligibility and capability. Shortlisted suppliers (typically 5-8) proceed to ITT stage.
restricted_sq.when_to_use: When the notice mentions 'restricted procedure', 'PQQ', 'pre-qualification', or 'selection questionnaire' as Stage 1.
restricted_sq.evaluation_method: Pass/fail on exclusion grounds + scored selection criteria (experience, capability, financial standing)

restricted_itt.name: Restricted Procedure — Invitation to Tender
restricted_itt.description: Stage 2 of restricted procedure. Full quality response + pricing, issued only to shortlisted suppliers after SQ stage.
restricted_itt.when_to_use: When you have been shortlisted from an SQ and receive an ITT invitation.
restricted_itt.evaluation_method: MAT — quality method statements scored 0-5 per question with descriptors, plus pricing

below_threshold.name: Below-Threshold / Simplified Procedure
below_threshold.description: Lighter-touch procurement for contracts under ~£213k (services threshold). Fewer formal requirements, often just a proposal document + pricing.
below_threshold.when_to_use: Contracts under £213k with simpler requirements, or where the notice uses language like 'quotation', 'proposal', or 'expression of interest'.
below_threshold.evaluation_method: Varies — may be quality/price split, best value, or quality-only

open_procedure.note: Default — used when no other type matches
